feature: Bounded frontlight restoration after partial I2C update failure
implementation: Remember the last successfully applied setting. After a bus failure, invalidate chip configuration and attempt that setting once. Return the original Bus error after successful restoration, or Restore containing both failures and discard the remembered setting after failed restoration. Initial failures without a successful setting retain the previous no-restoration behavior.
assertions: Failure at every operation of active-light changes, Off and activation from a known off state
Restoration recovers prior channel registers or standby and preserves unrelated bits
At most one restoration sequence, bounded by 16 additional register operations in tested cases
Failure at each operation of full nonzero restoration returns both errors and stops
Next request after failed restoration reconfigures and succeeds
Invalid ranges perform no I2C operations and preserve the last successful setting
Existing table, panel, input, battery, sleep and Wi-Fi board tests pass
commands: nix-shell --run 'cargo fmt --all && cargo test --locked -p femto-picco-board && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --features desktop,femto-catalog/tailnet --locked -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --all --check'

firmware_manifest.installation_status: No automatic installer. Verify the actual device partition table and recovery backup before installation.

limitations: Register simulation and firmware build do not establish physical brightness, warmth, current draw or recovery
Command timeout can still leave physical light state unknown
No new full workspace/native/network suite or grayscale build
